Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Cheltenham

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Cheltenham. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

We know what the south-east's heat, UV and hailstorms do to a roof over the years, so we quote on what your home actually needs. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Cheltenham: What We Commonly See

Cheltenham is a mix of post-war brick-veneer homes, older period houses and a growing number of newer townhouses and units around the Southland and Kingston precinct. A lot of the established homes still wear their original roofs, now faded and well past their best after decades of sun.

The work we are called out for most in Cheltenham is refixing cracked and slipped ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, fixing leaks around flashings and valleys, and replacing tired guttering. A sea breeze off the nearby bay adds a little salt to the mix, so coastal-side homes wear faster than you might expect.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Cheltenham

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Cheltenham homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and built to handle Melbourne's heat, UV and hailstorms, in a colour that suits your home.

Many older homes were built with roofs that contain asbestos cement sheeting. If that is your roof, we handle safe asbestos roof removal and replacement and finish the job in new COLORBOND® steel. We also convert older roofs to metal with our tile to tin service, and we will tell you honestly which option suits your home.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Cheltenham

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that let water in: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. After a hailstorm or a run of hot summers these are often the first things to fail, and we trace each leak back to its real source rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Cheltenham

Your quote depends on what your roof actually needs. Roof size, pitch and access, the type of steel and colour you choose, and how much plumbing work is involved are the main factors. We give you a clear written quote after an on-site inspection, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

Our Cheltenham Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Cheltenham Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Cheltenham locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Cheltenham Roofing FAQs

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Cheltenham

We also service nearby Mentone, Moorabbin, Highett, Heatherton and Parkdale.
